title: Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) Part Three: Message Header Extensions for Non-ASCII Text
summary: The third MIME document. It extends the older email message format to let non-ASCII text appear in header fields, such as names and subjects, using an encoding that older systems can still carry.

eli5.summary: It teaches email to put accented letters and other alphabets in the subject line by disguising them as plain letters.
